question: What do Rendanheyi/Haier case studies and the collapse/complexity literature (Tainter) establish?

item.title: Management innovation made in China: Haier’s Rendanheyi

findings.finding: Haier developed Rendanheyi to transform from a conventional hierarchical manufacturing firm to a highly responsive online-based entrepreneurial company; organizational, competitive, institutional and technological contexts mattered, so such innovations are context-dependent.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: This article shows how Haier developed a platform of management practices called Rendanheyi to transform itself from a conventional hierarchical manufacturing firm to a highly responsive online-based entrepreneurial company.

sources.population: Haier Group transformation from hierarchical manufacturer to platform of micro-enterprises
notFound: Body text is in a subscription journal; the Copenhagen repository copy has no PDF link.

item.title: Haier Group Announces Phase 2.0 of its Cornerstone ‘RenDanHeYi’ Business Model

findings.finding: Adopted in 2005; almost 200 internal micro-enterprises had been established, 77 percent of them with more than CNY 100 million in annual revenue in 2014; Haier’s 2014 profit was twelvefold the pre-transformation level, a 28 percent compound annual growth rate over nine years.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: Almost 200 such internal start-ups have been established to date, with 77 percent of these micro-enterprises realizing more than CNY 100 million (USD 15.7 million) in annual revenue last year.

findings.finding: Phase 2.0 turns Haier into a co-creation platform of micro-enterprises in which the company becomes a shareholder of its micro-enterprises and employees are entrepreneurs with decision-making authority who can distribute benefits.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: Haier as a company is no longer providing jobs to employees; we are instead offering a platform to become an entrepreneur.

notFound: Self-reported by Haier; no independent audit of the micro-enterprise revenue figures was read.

item.title: Discovering Haier’s management transformation process, the management guru Gary Hamel gives the prediction

findings.finding: After eliminating bureaucracy Haier was said to be a platform with more than 3,800 nodes of micro-enterprise, with employees turning into entrepreneurs; Hamel’s reported view was that decisions made only at the top of a hierarchy make failure inevitable.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: the company is now transforming into an platform, which accumulated more than 3,800 node of Microenterprise and thousands of micro-enterprise

notFound: Hamel’s own text was not read; this is Haier’s account of his presentation.

findings.finding: 2024 revenue RMB 285.971 billion, up 4.3 percent from RMB 274.198 billion (restated) in 2023; profit attributable to owners RMB 18.741 billion, up 12.9 percent; 122,733 employees at 31 December 2024 against 112,458.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: The total number of employees of the Group increased by 9.1% to 122,733 as at 31 December 2024 from 112,458 as at 31 December 2023.

findings.finding: The report defines Rendanheyi: Ren = creators, Dan = user value, Heyi = integration of values realised by employees and values created for users; it is applied in acquired companies as a value-added sharing mechanism for the whole-process team under a common goal.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: In Haier’s “Rendanheyi” (人 單 合 一) model, “Ren” refers to creators; “Dan” refers to user value; “Heyi” refers to the integration of values realised by employees and the values created for users.
